scope.mechanicsOwner: existing UseItemCommandV1, reviewed item registry, item operation journal, planner, reducer, recovery, and realtime paths
scope.extendedActions: transfer-first because durable activities require Trainer custody for their complete lifecycle

actorPolicy.gm: may select any current Trainer sheet
actorPolicy.player: may select only a Trainer explicitly linked to the selected authenticated Profile
actorPolicy.actorChoices: opaque, group-revision-bound and Trainer-revision-bound server identities
actorPolicy.targetScope: selected Trainer and that Trainer's unambiguous current roster under existing target eligibility

safeFields: opaque actor, offer and source-selection identities
acting Trainer display label and current revision
shared container, section, presentation-row, item and available-quantity labels
existing target eligibility, bounded choices, previews, timing, costs and acceptance notice

reservation.identity: exact item-instance:group source retained only in private command and journal evidence
reservation.quantity: reviewed consumption quantity reserved while an unresolved operation requires it
reservation.projection: shared Use and Transfer quantities subtract exact pending reservations; stack operations use the same reservation authority
reservation.unrelatedRows: remain mutable; pending settlement may rebase only the group aggregate revision after revalidating the exact source row, canonical definition, reserved quantity, actor, targets and every other original read

commitAuthority.declaration: reprojects the exact group revision, actor choice, source offer, target options and current reservation quantity before issuing a private template
commitAuthority.execution: reprojects by server-only actor slug, compares exact actor, group source and complete read set, then delegates to the existing authoritative context, eligibility, planner and reducer
commitAuthority.atomicity: source consumption, target mutations, group revision, item journal receipt and persisted realtime events commit together or roll back
commitAuthority.staleEvidence: initial actor delegation, Trainer revision, group revision, source row, canonical definition, quantity, reservation, campaign clock, target or bounded-choice drift fails before mutation; a pending row reservation tolerates only a newer group aggregate revision after exact source and all non-group reads revalidate
commitAuthority.replay: one exact operation command can be retried after uncertainty and cannot consume or apply mechanics twice
commitAuthority.responseAdoption: accepted authoritative group inventory replaces local state; affected sheet links are safe projections

interaction.composition: existing 60/40 inventory and inline decision workspace, collapsing to one column
interaction.actorControl: one 44px minimum Acting Trainer selector with textual custody and target-scope explanation
interaction.rowControl: Use appears beside Transfer and quieter stack controls only when group item-action authority is active
interaction.decision: existing TrainerSheetItemDecision target, choice, preview, acceptance and exact-retry anatomy
interaction.pendingBoundary: states exact quantity reservation and mechanical inertness until bounded GM acceptance
interaction.uncertainBoundary: exact retry is the only mutation path; actor switching, refresh, cancellation, editing and competing inventory actions remain blocked
